text:
samir: heads up — since the RBAC tweak earlier, SIEM is spiking on KMS.Decrypt attempts. ~12k alerts in last 30m. looks like service accounts with old role are hitting KMS and failing. anyone else seeing this?
maria: seeing same. dashboard CPU high. sample alert: `src=svc-payment principal=svc-legacy roleDenied=KMSDecrypt`
lee: can you paste the rule id? i want to mute at rule level while we fix mapping.
samir: rule id `kms_unauthed_decrypt_v2`. It's noisy because we rolled out role rename `svc/legacy->svc/payment` earlier. many pods still have old SA.
carter: propose short-term suppression: add exclusion if principal startswith `svc-legacy-` and request_count > 100? maybe better to enrich with `principal_cluster` then suppress for particular cluster.
maria: we should avoid blanket suppress. quick patch: change severity -> `info` and add tag `investigate/rbac-mismatch` so analysts can filter. I'll open the patch.
samir: here's a query to find top offending pods
```
index=kms_logs action=Decrypt status=Denied | top principal by count | where count>50
```
lee: nice. once we identify pods we can rollout SA update. also add an enrichment to attach `k8s_service` label before alerting.
siem-bot: deploy pipeline: patch `rule-engine` updated kms_unauthed_decrypt_v2 severity->info by maria at 1749981180 :white_check_mark:
iris: long-term fix: adjust rule to check `error_code=AccessDenied AND NOT principal startswith svc-operator` and require 3 unique principals in 5m before firing. reduces one-offs.
carter: +1. also add an eval job to run daily against historical 7d to detect FPs. can we add a dashboard tile showing `alerts_by_principal`?
maria: will do. action items: 1) temp severity->info (done) 2) run query to get top 50 principals (samir) 3) enrich pipeline with k8s labels (lee) 4) rule change to multi-principal threshold (iris) 5) update alert dashboard and create automation to auto-silence builders (carter).
samir: done running query, attaching top 10 in thread — svc-legacy-001, svc-legacy-012, svc-poc-3, svc-legacy-007... moving to rolling update.
lee: rolling update started in cluster eu-west1. will report back on residual alerts.
maria: thanks. follow-up: we should add an audit log check to ensure KMS request logged in `audit.kms_requests` so we don't lose visibility when we suppress.
